title: Tire width to rim internal width helper
description: Enter your tire width and choose the rim system. If the tire sidewall uses inches, switch to inch input and the value will be converted to millimetres for the DT Swiss chart lookup. The backend uses DT Swiss recommendation rows and linearly calculates every unlisted integer width bracketed by two chart points. The range is allowed to widen when the source data widens. It also shows display-only inflated-width and 105% aero projections; use the exact tire and rim manufacturer specifications for installation.
inchConversionNote: {inches} in ≈ {millimeters} mm; the chart lookup uses this millimetre width.
empty: Enter a tire width to see a DT Swiss recommended rim internal width.
loading: Calculating from the published backend reference…
outOfRange: This width is outside the calculable range of the current DT Swiss chart. Check the exact tire and rim manufacturer specifications.
noPublishedBracket: The chart has no bracket for this width. Check the exact tire and rim manufacturer specifications.
possibleReferenceNote: This row is a possible reference, not a recommended combination.
calculated: Linearly calculated between the DT Swiss {lowerTireWidth} mm and {upperTireWidth} mm data points.
calculatedFromPossibleReferenceNote: This calculation uses at least one possible-only data point. Treat it as a calculated reference, not a manufacturer recommendation.
physicsNote: The backend returns these as display-only geometry projections; they are not measured dimensions or safety limits.
